title: Tractor Drift 3D
desc: Master the art of tractor drifting in Tractor Drift 3D! Experience a unique mix of heavy machinery and high-speed sideways action. Chain smooth drifts, master the physics, and chase high scores on precision-built tracks. Raw Physics: Test your timing and throttle control with heavy machines. Progress: Unlock different tractors and find the perfect handling for your style. Leaderboards: Dominate the ranks with massive combos and perfect lines. Addictive gameplay that&rsquo;s easy to learn but hard to master. Prove that tractors can drift just as hard as any race car!
howto: Mouse click or tap to play
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
